decisions.context: Production cameras need defect detection even when the network is unavailable. The brief gives no latency target, but offline operation is explicit.

alternatives.label: Cloud inference
cons: Detection latency: adds network round trip

decisions.rationale: Offline operation decides the choice: inference must remain available without network access. This gives up the simpler hardware and centralized compute of cloud inference.
consequences: Devices must have enough compute and storage for the model.
Model runtime and hardware compatibility need management.

decisions.decision: Distribute weekly models for local installation
decisions.context: The model is retrained weekly and pushed to devices that may lack network access. Updates must fit intermittent connectivity.

alternatives.label: Device-initiated downloads
cons: Offline operation: devices cannot fetch while disconnected
Model freshness: update timing depends on connectivity

alternatives.label: Staged, resumable model packages
pros: Offline operation: packages can wait for connectivity
Model freshness: supports controlled weekly rollout
cons: Infrastructure cost: requires package hosting and rollout tracking

alternatives.label: Manual removable-media updates
pros: Offline operation: works without network access
cons: Low infrastructure cost: adds operator effort
Model freshness: rollout can be slow

decisions.rationale: Offline operation decides the choice: staged packages can be fetched when connected and installed later. This gives up the simplicity of direct downloads and requires rollout tracking.
consequences: Define package versioning and integrity checks.
Devices need storage for staged packages and the active model.

decisions.decision: Train weekly from a versioned image dataset
decisions.context: Newly labelled images drive weekly retraining, so each model should be traceable to the data and labels used. The brief does not specify a data platform.

alternatives.label: Versioned dataset snapshots
pros: Weekly model freshness: supports repeatable retraining
cons: Infrastructure cost: requires dataset storage and organization

alternatives.label: Train from a mutable image store
cons: Reproducibility: contents can change between runs

decisions.rationale: Reproducibility decides the choice: each weekly run can be tied to a fixed set of images and labels. This gives up the lower setup cost of a mutable store.
consequences: Retain dataset and label versions alongside model records.
Storage needs grow as snapshots accumulate.

decisions.context: A new model replaces the current defect detector on production devices. A staged rollout limits exposure if a weekly model is faulty.

alternatives.label: Validate then stage rollout
pros: Detection quality: catches regressions before broad release
Offline operation: allows gradual installation as devices connect
cons: Infrastructure cost: adds validation and rollout steps

alternatives.label: Push each trained model fleet-wide
pros: Weekly model freshness: fastest broad deployment
cons: Detection quality: errors affect the whole fleet
Low infrastructure cost: failures can create production disruption

decisions.rationale: Detection quality decides the choice: test and staged rollout reduce the impact of regressions. This gives up the speed and operational simplicity of an immediate fleet-wide push.
consequences: Keep a known-good model available for recovery.
Define validation criteria and rollout stages.

uncovered: Target inference latency and device hardware capabilities.
Defect classes, acceptable false-positive and false-negative rates, and validation metrics.
Image retention, labeling workflow, and dataset access controls.
Model format, runtime, package transport, and device identity/security.
Fleet size, connectivity patterns, update scheduling, rollback mechanism, and deployment success monitoring.
